findings.title: Dark placeholders use the UA grey
findings.evidence: editor-desktop-dark, navigation-desktop-dark, pages-mobile-dark; pixel sample and live computed ::placeholder rgb(117,117,117) under color-scheme dark on rgb(31,43,46) = 3.16:1 (light 4.61:1). Same grey in both themes = not themed.
findings.fix: One rule: ::placeholder { color: var(--ink); opacity: 1 } (or the existing muted token if it measures >=4.5:1 in every shipped theme).

findings.title: Populated workspace affordance slips
items: Ink toolbar renders aria-pressed modes (Type/Pen/Highlighter/Eraser) and commands (Undo ink/Redo ink/Add text) identically in one row; separate the command group (divider or gap).
Add-section '+' is a faint 32x34 glyph beside the 40px bordered add-page '+'; give it the shared icon-button treatment or a label.
Work queue uses a checkmark icon that reads as a checked state; use a neutral queue/inbox icon.
Document body inset 24px (desktop) / 16px (phone) from the title edge.
Phone empty: status row ~20px above the empty title.
Empty desktop header says 'Saved to server' before anything exists.
Header Settings has no current-page state.
Phone Settings link cloud wraps 3/2/1; orphan subtitle (owner-deferred).
Dark unselected radios are UA grey discs.

findings.evidence: Reported by Sol6 and traced by the parent; not re-tested by me. Scoped impact: a keyboard or screen-reader user on phone lands on BODY after the first page opens from the no-open-note state and must Tab back into the page; later chooser picks focus the title; no content or save risk. Blocks any keyboard/focus acceptance claim; does not block the scoped visual 8.

gates.states: partial: empty first run and populated only
gates.responsive: partial pass: 390 and 1280, manifest overflow 0 on all 22 captures

limits: Scoped KyNotes visual verdict only. WebKit, full theme/state/role/focus/contrast/soft-keyboard/dense-team acceptance unproven. No full-9, competitor or whole-suite claim. No merge or deploy authorization.
